description: Header file defining traits and functions for uninitialized resize and append operations on std::string, with support for custom member functions like __resize_default_init and __append_default_init.

classes.name: ResizeUninitializedTraits
classes.description: Trait to determine if a string type has a __resize_default_init method and to provide a resize method accordingly.

classes.name: AppendUninitializedTraits
classes.description: Trait to determine if a string type has a __append_default_init method and to provide an append method accordingly.

methods.name: ResizeUninitializedTraits::Resize
methods.description: Resizes the string, using __resize_default_init if available, otherwise using resize.

methods.name: AppendUninitializedTraits::Append
methods.description: Appends default-initialized characters, using __append_default_init if available, otherwise using append.
